question: The mode of the observations 35, 27, 27, 32, 25, 24, 27, 24, 32, 20, 31, 21, 29, 22, 27, 20 and 26 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **mode** is the value that appears most frequently in a data set.

Count the occurrences of each number in the given observations.

Frequency of 27 = 4 times (Highest frequency).

Frequency of 20, 24, and 32 = 2 times each.

All other numbers appear only once.

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**
